newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul students admit beating man who died.
newsitem.headline: Seoul students admit beating man who died.

text.p: Left-wing South Korean students on Wednesday admitted they had beaten a suspected police informer whose badly bruised body was delivered to a Seoul hospital on Wednesday.
The man was dead on arrival.
An official of the left-wing Hanchongryon student body told reporters the man had admitted during questioning that he was a police informer.
Lee Jun-ook told a news conference at Hanyang University that the man died in his sleep during the night after the beating, and students had delivered his corpse to a hospital on Wednesday morning.
"We are ready to take all responsibility," he said. "We are ready to cooperate with police so long as a fair investigation is promised."

Over the past several days, the college has been the scene of violent clashes between riot police and students organised by the Hanchongryon, which the Seoul government says takes orders from rival North Korea.
A police office died during clashes outside the campus on Monday. Students armed with metal pipes and petrol bombs have been demanding the resignation of President Kim Young-sam.
